夺舍修炼出元神的人，要在识海中吞噬元神，还要得到识海的认可。

可是就在这一刻，白黑提剑用剑背一下轰击在周梦月的肩膀上，巨大的力量直接压向了周梦月，周梦月在重压下直接跪在了白黑的面前。

李高远握紧方向盘，升起一股豪情。望着前方，看着车流，看着街道两边的行人，他发下了誓言。

“那不行，我们好端端的说话，你在后面偷听也就罢了，可是你笑什么呢？你必须你说清你笑什么才能走！”其中有人不高兴了，非让二娘们爹说为什么笑。

风元素的力量在我的手中汇聚，一道飓风从我的手间飞出，其方向不是别处，正是弓箭手落地的点位。

傲雪无语的看着自己的顶头上司，没办法两人公事几年，这个总监更像大姐亲人，两人相处的超级的好。

赵晓晨瞪大了眼睛，看清楚了，这把刀不是他手上的，更像是一个机关，他身上竟然穿着一件机关甲，而且这刀尖上还有很深的绿色，这一定是涂抹了剧毒。

这哪里还是人，眼中流落出的嗜血目光分明是比它们还凶残的妖兽。

置身于灵气当中，索性不去计较灵气流动，让灵气随着呼吸进入体内，灵气在头部一个凝缩点，这是修士的识海所在。当修为达到一定的境界，灵力化海的所在。

Those who seize their bodies to cultivate the soul must devour the soul in the sea of consciousness, and must also be recognized by the sea of consciousness.

But at this moment, Bai Hei raised his sword and struck Zhou Mengyue on the shoulder with the back of the sword. The huge force directly pressed against Zhou Mengyue, and Zhou Mengyue knelt directly in front of Bai Hei under the heavy pressure.

Li Gaoyuan tightened his grip on the steering wheel and felt a surge of pride.Looking ahead, looking at the traffic, looking at the pedestrians on both sides of the street, he made a vow.

"That's not okay. We are talking quietly and you can eavesdrop from behind. But what are you laughing at? You have to explain clearly what you are laughing at before you can leave!" One of them was unhappy and insisted on asking the second mother-in-law to explain why she was laughing.

The power of the wind element gathered in my hands, and a hurricane flew out of my hands. Its direction was not elsewhere, but at the point where the archer landed.

Aoxue looked at her immediate boss speechlessly. There was no way the two of them had been working together for several years. This director was more like an elder sister and a relative. The two of them got along very well.

Zhao Xiaochen's eyes widened and he saw clearly that the knife was not in his hand, but more like a mechanism. He was actually wearing a machine armor, and there was a deep green color on the tip of the knife, which must have been smeared with poison.

This is not a human being at all, the bloodthirsty look in his eyes is clearly that of a monster even more ferocious than them.

When you are in the aura, simply ignore the flow of the aura and let the aura enter the body with your breathing. The aura condenses at a point on the head, which is where the monk's sea of ​​consciousness lies.When cultivation reaches a certain level, spiritual power turns into the sea.
